'''Varmett''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
